title: Desktop app (Electron) with installers
description: Cross-platform Electron desktop app using web tech: secure main/preload/renderer split (context isolation, IPC), native save dialog, and electron-builder packaging into a Windows installer + portable .exe, macOS .dmg and Linux AppImage.
build: Build mode runs npm install and npm run dist, packaging for the current OS into release/
Windows .exe/installer: run `npm run dist:win` on Windows, or push to GitHub and use the 'Build executables' workflow
customize: src/index.html, src/renderer.js, src/styles.css: the UI (plain web code)
main.js: window creation, menus and ipcMain handlers for anything needing Node/OS access
preload.js: the only bridge between UI and main; expose new functions on window.api here
package.json "build": app id, product name, icons and installer targets
